name: Zoho

MTS (fresher).dsaDepth: Moderate — logic and implementation, not LeetCode-style; the programming rounds decide the outcome
rounds: Round 1: written test (aptitude, output prediction, C-style programming MCQs)
Round 2: programming round (simple programs: expression evaluation, string operations from an index, matrix and linked-list programs)
Round 3: advanced programming (scenario-based; often one application built in modules, e.g. a coloured-ball game)
Round 4: technical interview, resume-focused (OOP, data structures, DBMS)
extraTopics: Clean, working code under restricted libraries or timed conditions
MTS (fresher).notes: Reports say most selections hinge on the two programming rounds.
